// c4lock: #1157's reproducer. Four workers under GOMAXPROCS = 4, each pinned with runtime.LockOSThread, compute and
// sleep, so a locked M has to hand its P on while the others still need Ps (stoplockedm -> handoffp -> startm ->
// newm). On the Phase 4 fork at 944cfd2 that threw "on a locked thread with no template thread"; this guest is built
// from the fork commit that repairs it (PROVENANCE).
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
	"sync"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	const workers = 4
	runtime.GOMAXPROCS(workers)
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	for w := 0; w < workers; w++ {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func() {
			defer wg.Done()
			runtime.LockOSThread()
			defer runtime.UnlockOSThread()
			h := uint64(1)
			for round := 0; round < 20; round++ {
				for i := 0; i < 200_000; i++ {
					h = h*6364136223846793005 + 1442695040888963407
				}
				time.Sleep(time.Millisecond)
			}
			_ = h
		}()
	}
	wg.Wait()
	fmt.Println("done")
}
